the three titans trifecta

cash-cat: native solana: 9cRCn9rGT8V2imeM2BaKs13yhMEais3ruM3rPvTGpump basecat: native

i like to buy new coins to lead each relevant on chain eco into the new cycle, in my experience always a solid bet. this time around each one also is tied to a cult of personality and charismatic leader (vlad ansem cobie).

the most narcissistic one is obviously representing solana which fits to the culture of the chain while the other two are more subtle and represented by cat persona but its clear who the holders rely on

in my opinion robinhood and solana will keep leading with base far behind in the runner up. base being a contender at all after everything that happened is only possible because cobie's social ranking is extremely high. he is basically messi with the argentina team on this one, its a total carry job

the same is true for rh which is vlads chain and we dont have much data how he will be as a crypto leader. but so far he's doing pretty well, which is not surprising given he is a extremely competent founder and robinhood is a complete powerhouse. bonus points for being new and launching the chain at the bear bottom allowing everyone to get rich. i love robinhood chain

ansem has obvious staying power because he is the biggest kol and he can do whatever he wants. he is well connected and strongest in the fomo app/social trading sectors. he hass shown that he is willing to do whatever it takes and he wont give up on it in the first innings of the new cycle

all in all i think cashcat and ansem will hit 1 billion mcap each in due time, and it will be only a local top

basecat should be comfily in the 9 figures its just going to be chugging along. cobie+coinbase are the least likely to aggressively push imo

these plays are maximally simple because no roadmap is needed, the roadmap is the ecosystem as a whole. biggest meme is the easiest way to get leveraged exposure to the eco

i think cashcat will be the best performer and win vs ansem because you can also buy sol or pump they represent the same idea. for robinhood chain you can buy hood but its a stock its more messy. so you could say cashcat is the most liquid proxy for the robinhood *blockchain*

exciting times
